question: R-106 stopped at its smoke gate (seed 4778) before any training; no learner outcome exists. The smoke did its job and exposed two defects in MY new code, neither in the actor. Passed: joint order; zero-theta identity 0 mismatches over 702,607 env-steps; executed/proposed 0.980; reconstruction 0 mismatches (40 steps x 486 envs). Throughput at 2,048 envs is 33,800 transitions/s (the whole protocol projects to 0.41 h). Defect 1 (scoring, serious, caught by the A/A rollout): every slot scored 0.000 sustained success for the unchanged reference, which really succeeds on about 45% of cases. My child required length == 360 for a completed episode, but the env's time-out fires when episode_length_buf >= max - 1, so a completed episode has 359 recorded steps (cases.HORIZON's comment says so and the evaluator's reducer cases.sustained uses the last 60 of the episode's own length). Fix: score with the evaluator's own rule (completed and the predicate on the final 60 steps of the episode's own length), implemented as a pure function with a unit test that it equals cases.reduce_episodes on synthetic traces including a 359-step time-out. Because of this bug the A/A noise yardstick was not measured (all zeros). Slot drops were 27/25/25/25 of 512, so slots are close but not identical. Defect 2 (a mis-specified gate): 'the two +probe slots act identically at step 0' was tested bit for bit and failed, although +probe differs from -probe and from zero as required. Identical placements in different environments do not give bit-identical observations (positions are world-frame values minus per-environment origins, so float32 rounding differs by slot). Fix: require max |difference| <= 1e-4 between the two +probe slots' step-0 actions and report the measured value. Proposed amendment, as in R-103: fix exactly these two things; keep the failed attempt under logs/pen_spin/r106_exact_success_ars/attempt1_smoke/ as a recorded deviation; rerun the whole smoke once on NEW seed 4792 (4778 spent; training seed 4779 and confirmation seeds 4780-4791 untouched and unseen); any further smoke failure closes R-106 as inconclusive. Budget: attempt 1 made 8,204 starts, which stay charged; with the rerun (about 8,200), training (about 98,400) and confirmation (6,144 charged) the total is about 121,000, above the 115,000 ceiling by the cost of the failed smoke only. I propose raising the ceiling to 125,000 now, before any learner outcome, rather than cutting an update or the confirmation; everything else in the frozen configuration is unchanged. The user has delegated such decisions to me with your advice. Do you agree?
